DAMGHANI:v1p443/r10.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p443/r10.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p443/r10.claim: Tamhīd means establishing or preparing something for someone.
DAMGHANI:v1p443/r10.anchor: الثانى : التمهيد التوطين . قوله سبحانه فى سورة المدثر

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.claim: Affluent leaders of Makkah and Ṭāʾif mistook wealth for proof that they were God's favorites and expected still more; Muhammad should leave their fate to God.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.anchor: These verses admonish the megalomaniac leaders of Makkah

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.claim: The passage describes a general wealthy, high-status mentality, not Walīd ibn Mughīrah alone, though it applies to him too.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.anchor: there is no reason for restricting the verse to him

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r6.claim: Wealth and sons paved the way to social respect, dignity, leadership, and influence.

QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r1.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r1.claim: God made the man capable of freely conducting affairs and managing his activities.
QUSHAYRI:v3p364/r1.anchor: تسهيل التصرف ، أي : مكنته من التصرف في الأمور

MUQATIL:104:1-5/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:104:1-5/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:104:1-5/r1.claim: God had fully expanded the man's wealth; he still hoped for more, but God calls him obstinate toward the signs.
MUQATIL:104:1-5/r1.anchor: بسطت له في المال كل البسط، ثم يطمع أن أزيد كلا إنه كان لآياتنا عنيدا

RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r1.claim: God spread al-Walīd’s broad standing and leadership among his people, completing the blessings of wealth and social rank.
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r1.anchor: وبسطت له الجاه العريض والرياسة في قومه فأتممت عليه نعمتي المال والجاه

RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r2.claim: Wealth and rank together constitute worldly perfection in the eyes of worldly people.
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r2.anchor: واجتماعهما هو الكمال عند أهل الدنيا

RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r3.claim: The idiom “May God prolong his tamhīd” means extending a person’s standing and discretion in affairs.
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r3.anchor: ولهذا المعنى يدعى بهذا فيقال أدام الله تمهيده أي بسطته وتصرفه في الأمور

RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r4.speaker: بعض المفسرين
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r4.claim: Some exegetes take the preparation to mean ample livelihood and a long life.
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r4.anchor: ومن المفسرين من جعل هذا التمهيد البسطة في العيش وطول العمر

RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r5.claim: Al-Walīd was among Quraysh’s leading men and was nicknamed al-Waḥīd and Rayḥānat Quraysh.
RAZI-FULL:v30p176/r5.anchor: وكان الوليد من أكابر قريش ولذلك لقب الوحيد وريحانة قريش

STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.claim: The verses are applied specifically to al-Walīd’s great wealth, seven or ten sons, learning, and eloquence among Quraysh.
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.anchor: These verses are said to refer specifically to the great fortune that God had bestowed upon al-Walīd, who was among the wealthiest men in Makkah

TAB-FULL:v23p424/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r2.claim: God says He spread out and eased al-Walīd’s worldly life.
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r2.anchor: وقوله: {ومهدت له تمهيدا} [المدثر: 14] يقول تعالى ذكره: وبسطت له في العيش بسطا

TAB-FULL:v23p424/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r3.speaker: سفيان
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r3.claim: Sufyān glosses the phrase as having spread things out for him.
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r3.anchor: عن سفيان، {ومهدت له تمهيدا} [المدثر: 14] قال: بسط له

TAB-FULL:v23p424/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r4.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r4.claim: Mujāhid says the provision spread out for him consisted of wealth and children.
TAB-FULL:v23p424/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {ومهدت له تمهيدا} [المدثر: 14] قال: من المال والولد

TABATABAI:74:12-25/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r3.claim: Tamhīd means preparation and figuratively refers to abundance of wealth and status and well-ordered affairs.
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r3.anchor: التمهيد التهيئة ويتجوز به عن بسطة المال والجاه وانتظام الأمور

BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r12.claim: God expanded al-Walīd’s leadership and prestige, completing worldly favor; worldly standards treat wealth and status together as perfection.
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r12.anchor: وبسطت له الرياسة واجاه العريض فأتممت عليه النعمة

BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r13.claim: Al-Walīd was called Rayḥānat Quraysh, “Quraysh’s fragrant plant”; the passage also mentions offspring and provision.

BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.claim: The Najmī allusion makes al-Walīd the solitary evil soul; his wealth, bad traits, followers, and prestige symbolize sins and the dark natural powers of a rebellious self.
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.anchor: وفي التأويلات النجمية : يشير إلى الوليد بن مغيرة

BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.claim: Abū Bakr the hidden, ʿUmar the spirit, ʿUthmān the secret, and ʿAlī the heart use spiritual light to erase the self’s darkness, defeat its deeds and followers, and end its dominion.
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.anchor: يعني دعني وإياه فإني أسلط عليه أبا بكر الخفي وعمر الروح وعثمان السر وعلى القلب

TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r1.claim: Aṭ-Ṭabrisī explains that God spread out his livelihood until he was provided for in every respect.
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r1.anchor: بسطت له في العيش بسطا حتى صار مكفي المؤونة من كل وجه

TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r2.speaker: الحسن
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r2.claim: Al-Ḥasan describes the result as his circumstances becoming well ordered and harmonious.
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r2.anchor: حتى صارت أحواله متناسبة عن الحسن وغيره

TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r3.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r3.claim: An alternative gloss is that God made matters easy for him.
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r3.anchor: عن الحسن وغيره. وقيل: سهلت له.

TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r4.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r4.claim: Another gloss says God facilitated his ability to manage affairs.
TABRISI:74:11-31#2/r4.anchor: وقيل: سهلت له التصرف في الأمور تسهيلا

THALABI:v10p71/r15.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r15.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p71/r15.claim: God made al-Walid's life broad and comfortable.
THALABI:v10p71/r15.anchor: ومهدت له تمهيدا أي بسطت له في العيش بسطا

THALABI:v10p71/r16.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v10p71/r16.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas interprets the phrase as wealth piled one layer upon another, like bedding spread out.
THALABI:v10p71/r16.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: يعني المال بعضه على بعض كما تمهد الفرش ثم يطمع

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r1.speaker: مجاهد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r1.claim: Mujahid says God made matters easy for him through wealth and children.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r2.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r2.claim: Muqatil says God expanded al-Walid’s wealth and children for him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r2.anchor: وقال مقاتل: بسطت له في المال والولد بسطا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r3.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi says God extended his wealth for him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r3.anchor: وقال الكلبي: مهدت له في المال الممدود

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r4.claim: Tamhīd means making it easy to manage affairs; the blessing “may God continue your tamhīd” means extending someone’s ease and agency.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r4.anchor: ومعنى التمهيد: تسهيل التصرف في الأمور

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r5.speaker: بعض المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r5.claim: Some commentators take the tamhīd as abundance in livelihood and long life.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p421/r5.anchor: من جعل هذا التمهيد البسط في العيش وطول العمر

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r4.claim: God spread out comfort, livelihood, and wealth for him.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r4.anchor: بسطت له في العيش والمال بسطا

ELMALILI:74:14-25/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r1.claim: Beyond wealth and sons, God prepared many means for al-Walid and granted him standing, grandeur, and good fortune.
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r1.anchor: mal ve oğullardan başka, birçok esbâb ihzar ederek câh ve haşmet ü ikbal de verdim

ELMALILI:74:14-25/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r2.claim: Al-Walid was counted among Quraysh's leading notables and was known as Wahid and Rayhanat Quraysh.
ELMALILI:74:14-25/r2.anchor: Velîd Kureyş içinde vücûhtan, sanâdîdden sayılırdı

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.claim: The passage’s general lesson is that gratitude to the giver of blessings is a basic moral duty grounded in reason and justice.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.anchor: Nimete karşı şükretmek, nimet sahibine minnettar olmak en yalın ahlâkî ödevlerden biri, akıl ve adalet gereğidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.claim: Failing to thank God for life and material and spiritual gifts is grave ingratitude, especially when it advances denial, polytheism, and injustice.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.anchor: varlığımızı, hayatımızı, sahip olduğumuz, yararlandığımız her türlü maddî ve mânevî nimet ve imkânları lutfeden Allah’a minnettar olmamak, şükretmemek

BURHAN:v1p78/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p78/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p78/r1.claim: Qur'anic endings suit the preceding meaning; their four forms are tamkīn, tawshīḥ, īghāl, and taṣdīr, distinguished by placement and whether their cue is verbal or semantic.
BURHAN:v1p78/r1.anchor: وهى منحصرة فى أربعة أشياء التمكين والتوشيح والإيغال والتصدير

BURHAN:v1p78/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p78/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p78/r2.claim: Tamkīn prepares the ending so it settles naturally in place, depends on the whole statement, and cannot be removed without disturbing meaning or comprehension.
BURHAN:v1p78/r2.anchor: الأول التمكين وهو أن تمهد قبلها تمهيدا تأتى به الفاصلة ممكنة فى مكانها مستقرة فى قرارها

NAHHAS:v5p65/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p65/r20.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p65/r20.claim: تمهيدا is an emphatic verbal noun.

ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r4.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r4.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r4.claim: God gave his life wide scope by endowing him with potentialities beyond those of other living beings.
ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r4.anchor: to whose life I gave so wide a scope

ASAD-NOTES:74:11#n6/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:11#n6/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:11#n6/r1.claim: The expression means that God spread life wide for him, endowing him with potentialities beyond those of other living beings.
ASAD-NOTES:74:11#n6/r1.anchor: whom I have endowed with potentialities far beyond those open to other living beings

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.claim: Meccan opponents repeatedly alleged that the Quran was human fabrication, borrowed ancient lore, or material copied from earlier writings and dictated to Muhammad; the Quran records these charges and reasons against their falsehood.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.anchor: ويسجل القرآن مفترياتهم لا يكتمها، ويجادلهم فيها بما يهدي كل ذي عقل وبصيرة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.claim: Al-Muddaththir is the counterpart of the preceding al-Muzzammil; their central themes are essentially the same and their names share a meaning.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.anchor: There is no essential difference between the central themes of both sūrahs .

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.claim: Verses 11–17 warn that Judgment Day will be severe for disbelievers who presume their wealth and rank will bring them still more.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.anchor: The Prophet (sws) should well inform the people about the afflictions of the Day of Judgement.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.claim: God later bestowed wealth and status, but instead of gratitude the man became conceited and vain.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.anchor: conceit and vanity overcame them and they held that whatever they had was their right by birth

IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.author: Ibn Hishām
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.speaker: الوليد بن المغيرة
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.claim: At the pilgrimage season, Quraysh ask al-Walid for a single story about Muhammad; after rejecting soothsayer, madman, poet, and sorcerer as accurate descriptions, he recommends calling him a sorcerer because people see him as dividing families.
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.anchor: ثم إن الوليد بن المغيرة اجتمع إليه نفر من قريش، وكان ذا سن فيهم، وقد حضر الموسم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r1.claim: He paved, prepared, and spread a comfortable footing for him so he could remain settled in his town and consult at ease.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r1.anchor: أي وطأت وهيأت وبسطت له بساطا حتى أقام ببلدته مطمئنا يرجع إلى رأيه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas understands the provision as territory extended from Yemen to Syria.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: وسعت له ما بين اليمن إلى الشام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r3.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r3.claim: Mujahid takes the phrase as wealth laid out in layers, like bedding is spread.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p329/r3.anchor: وقال مجاهد: مهدت له المال بعضه فوق بعض، كما يمهد الفراش

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r1.claim: God gave him broad authority and standing, completing the worldly pair of wealth and prestige that worldly people regard as perfection.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r1.anchor: الرياسة والجاه العريض فأتمت عليه نعمتي الجاه والمال واجتماعهما هو الكمال عند أهل الدنيا

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r2.claim: The root sense is smoothing and preparing; “tamhīd” is figuratively used for ample wealth and status.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r2.anchor: وأصل التمهيد التسوية والتهيئة وتجوز به عن بسطة المال والجاه

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r3.claim: His attractive prosperity earned him the nickname “the fragrance of Quraysh,” and he was called “the Unique” as the one deemed most entitled to leadership.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r3.anchor: يلقب ريحانة قريش وكذا كانوا يلقبونه بالوحيد

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says God expanded his dominion from Yemen to Syria.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r4.anchor: وعن ابن عباس وسعت له ما بين اليمن إلى الشام

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r5.speaker: مجاهد
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r5.claim: Mujāhid interprets the phrase as wealth layered upon wealth, like bedding being spread.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122#3/r5.anchor: وعن مجاهد مهدت له المال بعضه فوق بعض

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r3.claim: God spread out his comfortable life and gave him a long life.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r3.anchor: {ومهدت له تمهيدا} أي: بسطت له في العيش وطول العمر بسطا.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r4.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r4.claim: Al-Kalbi says the phrase describes wealth piled one layer over another, like bedding being spread.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p267/r4.anchor: وقال الكلبي: يعني المال بعضه على بعض كما يمهد الفرش.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:14-17/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:14-17/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:14-17/r1.claim: God gave him broad leadership and prestige, so he was called the Fragrant Plant of Quraysh and al-Waḥīd; he had been deemed worthy of precedence.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:14-17/r1.anchor: وبسطت له الرياسة والجاه العريض حتى لقب ريحانة قريش والوحيد أي باستحقاقه الرياسة والتقدم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r11.claim: God gradually prepared al-Walid’s leadership and prestige, winning him both material possession and people’s hearts, prolonging his life, removing obstacles, and making elders seek his counsel.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r11.anchor: وطأت وبسطت وهيأت في الرئاسة بأن جمعت له إلى ملك الأعيان ملك المعاني التي منها القلوب

BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says God gave him lands stretching from Yemen to Syria and completed his worldly fortune; he was called al-Wahid and Rayhanat Quraysh as the leading man of his clan.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : وسعت له ما بين اليمين إلى الشام فأكملت له من سعادة الدنيا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p225/r2.claim: Tamheed emphasizes the thorough extent of the preparation and comfort God gave him.

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r5.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r5.claim: Mujahid explains that God spread out al-Walid’s wealth and children for him.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد {ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا} قال: نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r5.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r5.claim: Mujahid explains that God spread out wealth and children for him.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r5.anchor: ومهدت له تمهيدا قال : بسطت له من المال والولد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r8.claim: Tamhīd is the verbal noun of intensive mahhada; the root image is leveling ground and removing what hurts someone lying on it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r8.anchor: والتمهيد : مصدر مهد بتشديد الهاء الدال على قوة المهد . والمهد : تسوية الأرض

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r9.claim: Here ‘preparing thoroughly’ is a metaphor for making al-Walid's affairs easy and his word influential, with no request difficult for him.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r9.anchor: والتمهيد هنا مستعار لتيسير أموره ونفاذ كلمته في قومه بحيث لا يعسر عليه مطلب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r10.claim: The verbal noun is an accusative cognate object emphasizing ‘I prepared’; its indefiniteness magnifies the preparation, though emphasis does not invariably rule out metaphor.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r10.anchor: وأكد { مهدت } بمصدره على المفعولية المطلقة ليتوسل بتنكيره لإفادة تعظيم ذلك التمهيد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.claim: The blessings are recalled as a prelude to reproaching al-Walid and warning him of worldly harm and afterlife punishment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.anchor: ووصف في هذه الآية بما له من النعمة والسعة لأن الآية في سياق الامتنان عليه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.claim: This contrasts with 68:10's account of his vices; that verse may concern al-Walid, but the identification is only a possibility, since its context warns against his harm and treachery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.anchor: فأما في آية سورة القلم فقد وصفه بما فيه من النقائص في قوله تعالى : { ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r13.claim: تمهيد means preparation and making provision.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r14.speaker: سفيان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r14.claim: Sufyan explains the phrase as God spreading life out for him comfortably.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r14.anchor: قال سفيان: المعنى بسطت له العيش بسطا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p405#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p405#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p405#2/r1.claim: God spread ease of living for him and granted him a long life.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p405#2/r1.anchor: ومهدت له تمهيدا أي بسطت له العيش وطول العمر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#3/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#3/r1.claim: God gave him access to many kinds of wealth, furnishings, and other worldly provision.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#3/r1.anchor: أي: مكنته من صنوف المال والأثاث وغير ذلك،

JISHUMI:v10p7156/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r1.claim: Tamhīd, tawṭiʾa, tadhليل, and tashīl are near-synonyms; preparing enables and eases someone’s dealings.
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r1.anchor: التمهيد والتوطئة والتذليل والتسهيل نظائر، ومهدت له أي: مكنته، وسهلت له التصرف في الأمور.

JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.claim: The passage is said to concern al-Walid ibn al-Mughira al-Makhzumi, wealthy with sons and called al-Wahid among his people, according to Ibn Amir.
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.anchor: قيل: نزلت هذه الآيات في الوليد بن المغيرة المخزومي، وكان له مال وبنون، قال ابن عامر: وكان يسمى الوحيد في قومه،

JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.claim: In the story, al-Walid rejects calling Muhammad a soothsayer, poet, or madman, then chooses “magician” and says the Qur’an separates families.
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.anchor: ثم اختلفوا، فقيل: إنه أتى قريشا في ناديها، وقال: هذا الموسم، والناس يسألون عن محمد،

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.claim: Abundant blessings make disobedience toward the Benefactor more serious.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.anchor: تدل الآيات على أن كثرة النعم توجب عظم عصيان المنعم.

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.claim: God grants blessings to unbelievers, contrary to the Mujbira.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.anchor: وتدل على أن لله تعالى على الكفار نعما، خلاف قول المجبرة.

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.claim: Worldly conditions and goods are blessings from God.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.anchor: وتدل على أن أحوال الدنيا من نعمه تعالى.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r17.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r17.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r17.claim: God prepared extensive status and leadership, completing the worldly ideal of wealth and prestige.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r17.anchor: وبسطت له الجاه العريض والرياسة في قومه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r18.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r18.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r18.claim: The idiom asking God to sustain someone's support and preparation means wishing increased prestige and honor.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r18.anchor: آدام الله تأييدك وتمهيدك ، يريدون : زيادة الجاه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r19.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r19.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r19.claim: Al-Walīd was a leading Quraysh notable, explaining his epithets al-Waḥīd and Rayḥānat Quraysh.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r19.anchor: وكان الوليد من وجهاء قريش وصناديدهم

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r23.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r23.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r23.claim: Mujahid says God furnished him with wealth and children.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r23.anchor: أحدها : مهدت له من المال والولد , قاله مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r24.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r24.speaker: ابن شجرة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r24.claim: Ibn Shajara says God furnished him with leadership among his people.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r24.anchor: الثاني : مهدت له الرياسة في قومه , قاله ابن شجرة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r25.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r25.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r25.claim: A further possibility is that he was settled in his homeland, without fear or need to dislodge him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r25.anchor: ويحتمل ثالثا : أنه مهد له الأمر في وطنه حتى لا ينزعج عنه بخوف ولا حاجة .

MUQATIL:74:11-17/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r4.claim: God had generously expanded al-Walid's wealth, sons, and good fortune.
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r4.anchor: { ومهدت له تمهيدا } [آية: 14] يقول: بسطت له في المال والولد والخير بسطا { ثم يطمع أن أزيد }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p295#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295#3/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295#3/r1.claim: God broadened his status and leadership, completing worldly blessings of wealth and rank; their combination is perfection for worldly people.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295#3/r1.anchor: وبسطت له الجاه والرياسة فأتممت عليه نعمتي الجاه والمال واجتماعهما هو الكمال عند أهل الدنيا

QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r1.claim: God spread ease and luxury around al-Walid so he could live secure and comfortable in his town, acting at discretion.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r1.anchor: أي بسطت له في العيش بسطا، حتى أقام ببلدته مطمئنا مترفها

QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r2.claim: In Arabic, tamhid means preparing and making something ready, as when preparing a child’s bed.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r2.anchor: والتمهيد عند العرب: التوطئة والتهيئة ومنه مهد الصبي

QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas and Mujahid say the preparation was ample territory between Yemen and Syria.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r3.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: { ومهدت له تمهيدا } أي وسعت له ما بين اليمن والشام

QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r4.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r4.claim: Mujahid also says it means wealth piled on wealth, like bedding.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:14-16/r4.anchor: وعن مجاهد أيضا في { ومهدت له تمهيدا } أنه المال بعضه فوق بعض
